title: Evaluation of Blood-Based Systemic Inflammatory and Immunological Markers for the Detection of Infections in Liver Transplant Patients
summary: Die frühzeitige Diagnose und Behandlung von Infektionen und Sepsis sind von zentraler Bedeutung, da eine Verzögerung einer adäquaten antiinfektiven Therapie mit einer erhöhten Morbidität und Mortalität einhergeht. Aus Parametern des routinemäßig erhobenen Blutbildes lassen sich verschiedene inflammatorische und immunologische Indizes ableiten. Hierzu zählen die Neutrophilen-Lymphozyten-Ratio (NLR), die Platelet Lymphocyte-Ratio (PLR), der Systemic Immune-Inflammation Index (SII) sowie das Verhältnis des Mean Platelet Volume zur Thrombozytenzahl (MPV/PLT). Diese Indizes werden ohne zusätzliche studienbedingte Blutentnahmen oder spezielle Laboranalytik aus routinemäßig erhobenen Parametern bestimmt.

interventions.name: The study includes adult and pediatric patients who have undergone a liver transplant and who were treated—or are being treated—at least once in the intensive care unit at Hannover Medical School during the inpatient stay directly associated with the transplant. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Adult and pediatric patients who have undergone liver transplantation at the MHH.
• At least one episode of intensive care treatment during the inpatient stay directly associated with the liver transplantation.
• Availability of the routine clinical, laboratory, and microbiological data required for the respective analysis within the defined observation period.
Exclusion criteria:
Cases with documentation that is insufficient or implausible for the specific research question will be excluded from the corresponding analysis. Additional exclusion criteria may be specified once the final definition of infection and the analysis window have been determined.
